oos_paper_sharpe_decay_est.note: 20-30% Sharpe decay from slippage + fee drag expected post-live

risks.name: Paper vs LIVE Sharpe divergence
risks.detail: OOS Sh 50.79 → live est 35.5 (20-30% decay). High OOS Sharpe = more decay risk (overfitting to historical FR cycles).
risks.mitigation: Post-only fill optimization; 7d live monitoring gate; rollback < Sh 15

risks.name: HL + Bybit cross-venue sync failure
risks.detail: If Bybit leg fails to fill while HL ATOM leg fills → uncovered directional exposure
risks.mitigation: K439 rollback: cancel HL leg within 5s if Bybit fails. Monitor cross-venue sync daily.

risks.name: Cosmos hypothesis maintenance
risks.detail: ATOM FR differential driven by IBC flows + staking yield competition + governance cycles. If IBC network effect weakens or staking APY converges with market, signal degrades.
risks.mitigation: Monitor ATOM staking yield vs BTC funding. Check G5a correlation monthly.

risks.name: BTC flash crash (correlated leg risk)
risks.detail: BTC -20% flash crash: all BTC-short legs gain, ATOM-long leg loses. Delta-neutral design absorbs price move. Tail loss est 1.7-4.0%.
risks.mitigation: K357 emergency exit registered. HL margin monitored. Delta drift alert > 10%.

risks.name: HL cap breach during Week 3 activation
risks.detail: K493 adds 2.5pp HL → 60.5% (cap 65%). If Week 1+2 used more HL than planned, breach risk increases.
risks.mitigation: Verify HL pct via verify_deployment_status.py before activation. Use Bybit split.

risks.name: G6 low-frequency gate (18.2/yr)
risks.detail: K493 only fires ~18 trades/yr (confirmed G6 FAIL). Long holding periods mean slippage per trade is amortized but signal is slow to adapt.
risks.mitigation: Accepted at reduced sizing (3% sleeve). Monitor signal count vs expected 18.2/yr.
